note: Recorded verifications that a held source identifies a trial arm's dose (harness/recorded_verification.py). A dose label is never inferred by a pattern over prose (codex copps-r15/r16: 'reduced to 30 mg' in the high-dose arm, a 30 mg low-dose arm reduced to 15 mg). Each entry is bound to the sha256 of the exact held text it was checked against. No entry exists for ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48 (24251359): its held abstract states no doses, so the NOAC lower-dose analysis stays NOT_COMPUTED_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE.
